geographicReview.notes: Exact mapped Q3087620 bridge axis and published 73.3 × 16.7 m exterior reviewed against independent current GSI DEM1A ground. The independent east road plateau at native X 40 m is 41.733 m. All eight current production terrain images inspected, including OSM carriageway/sidewalk approach geometry: clipped connector surfaces meet both modeled road ends without duplicate bridge spans or tiny inferred connector piers. The endpoint rays +2.25/+0.73 m are over the steep abutment-bank faces, not the upper road plateau, and are retained. The 1 m laser DEM preserves 6,630 null river cells; unknown riverbed is omitted and never filled or treated as zero. Host must supply fine terrain and sampleStructureTerrain using the same bank reference consistently across all resident tiles; without this callback the extended model remains deferred and its procedural fallback stays visible. No underwater footing/bathymetry survey or universal compatibility with coarse global DEM is claimed. Current district and closeup derivatives were independently rerendered on the same preserved GSI1m ground and OSM approach-road context; all8new images inspected, connections remain continuous. Curbs/deck ends and absolute model datum match the unchanged master. Terrain evidence was rebound with explicit proof of identical master/placement, without changing heights/no-data. No riverbed or physical-device performance claim.
